# LedgerCloseMeta golden checks

<!-- generated by tools/check-lcm.mjs; do not edit. CI fails if stale. -->

Every corpus entry with a ledger is checked against two references, offline, from files in this repo. Verdicts: **agrees**, **diverges**, **no_golden**.

- **core**: stellar-core's own LedgerCloseMeta test goldens for the same protocol (`src/testdata/ledger-close-meta-v2-protocol-<P>[-soroban].json` at stellar-core `f2b91947`, vendored in `corpus/goldens/stellar-core`). They are synthetic ledgers, so only shape is compared: LCM version, header ledger_version, StellarValueExt arm, CAP-88 `close_time_ms == close_time*1000`, TransactionMeta version and LedgerCloseMetaV2 field set. The LedgerCloseMetaExt arm is shown but not part of the verdict (it depends on how the producing node is configured).
- **rpc**: a second copy of the same ledger from Stellar RPC `getLedgers` (`corpus/datalake/testnet-rpc`), compared with the Galexie archive copy byte for byte; when they differ, the parts that differ are listed.

## RPC returns different bytes for the same ledger

Recorded by `node tools/check-lcm.mjs --fetch` (`corpus/datalake/rpc-variance.json`): 8 ledgers, 6 `getLedgers` requests each to the public testnet endpoint.

| Ledger | Distinct LCM byte strings | Any equal to the archive copy |
|---|---|---|
| 5698682 | 4 of 6 | no |
| 5699707 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718664 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718666 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718667 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718668 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718669 | 3 of 6 | no |
| 5718670 | 2 of 6 | no |

Across all stored archive/RPC pairs, the parts that differ are: LedgerCloseMetaExt arm; diagnostic events; op ledger-entry changes: order only, state/updated pairs intact. Identical in every pair: ledger_header, tx_set, tx results, op contract events, upgrades_processing, evicted_keys. A consumer that hashes LCM bytes, or depends on change order or diagnostic events, gets different results depending on which copy it read.
